newsitem.title: UK: Wuerttembergische Hypo sets two 100 mln mark bonds.
newsitem.headline: Wuerttembergische Hypo sets two 100 mln mark bonds.

text.p: Wuerttembergische Hypothekenbank AG, Stuttgart has launched two 100 million mark step-up bonds, the lead managers said on Friday.

GZB-Bank has underwritten a 100 million mark oeffentlicher Pfandbrief series 867 maturing on July 1, 2002. It pays a coupon of 4.0 percent in the first year, 4.25 in year two, 4.75 in year three, 5.00 in year four and 5.75 percent in year five.
Issue price is 99.80 and payment date is July 1.

Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has underwritten a 100 million mark oeffentlicher Pfandbrief series 868 maturing on December 19, 2002. It pays a coupon of 4.125 percent until December 19, 1997, and 5.00 percent thereafter if not called at par.
Issue price is 99.85 and payment date is June 23.
